# `Q-5-45` — book-scope chapter Ignored for a Whole-Book Render

> A project, directory or document `book-scope: chapter` was ignored in a render of the whole book.

## What this means

A `book-scope: chapter` set in `_quarto.yml`, a `_metadata.yml` or a document applies when one chapter is rendered. It does not turn a whole-book render (`q2 render` with no file) into a chapter render, and it is not an error.

## How to fix

Nothing to fix. To render one chapter, name it (`q2 render ch1.qmd`).
